_comment: Transcribed from Çizelge 7 (MADDE 15) of the official circular named in
`source` below, read from the Resmî Gazete text on mevzuat.gov.tr.
Entries are keyed by the catalogue's scientific species key, never by a
common name. The circular lists Akya (Lichia amia) at 40 cm and Sarıkuyruk
(Seriola dumerili) at 30 cm; matching on the Turkish word would have
attached one fish's limit to the other.
A species absent from Çizelge 7 is deliberately absent here too, so the
tool keeps refusing for it. The circular's 'Diğer türler' row says those
have no minimum length, but it is the per-species silence that is safe to
report, not an inference about any particular fish.
`general_rules` applies to every answer for this region and is surfaced
with the citation; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md -> 'Regulatory data'.

source.title_tr: 6/2 Numaralı Amatör Amaçlı Su Ürünleri Avcılığının Düzenlenmesi Hakkında Tebliğ (Tebliğ No: 2024/21), Çizelge 7
source.title_en: Circular No. 6/2 on the Regulation of Recreational Fishing (Circular No. 2024/21), Table 7

tr: Boy limiti belirtilen türlerde %5 küçük boylara istisna tanınır.
Kg cinsinden limit verilen türlerde, avlanan tür tek veya karışık olsun günlük toplam 5 kg'ı geçemez.
Adet sınırlamasına tabi birden fazla tür avlandığında toplam balık sayısı 3'ü geçemez.
Çizelge 7'de yer almayan türler için asgari boy limiti yoktur; kg limiti uygulanır.
Bu kurallar 1/9/2024 - 31/8/2028 av dönemi içindir ve tebliğ değişiklikleriyle güncellenebilir.
en: A 5% tolerance below the stated minimum length is allowed.
For species limited by weight, the daily total may not exceed 5 kg, whether of one species or mixed.
When several count-limited species are taken, the total number of fish may not exceed 3.
Species absent from Table 7 have no minimum length; the weight limit still applies.
These rules cover the 1/9/2024 - 31/8/2028 season and can change by amendment.
